text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the press conference for the Satsuki 
Sho held on this day, Tokai Teio declared 
in her interview that she would become a 
"Triple Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the object of her "admiration" is 
far away and not easily reached. In order 
to catch up to and surpass Symboli Rudolf, 
who awaits at the lofty heights—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio dashed off, declaring that she 
would train harder than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf quietly watched over Tokai 
Teio from the shadows... murmuring that 
she would be waiting for her to reach her 
level.
